cohort: 390 pregnant women in their third trimester (≥ 37 weeks gestation) at Lady Reading Hospital Peshawar
finding: Raised pre-pregnancy BMI (≥ 25) was significantly associated with increased risk of postpartum hemorrhage, genital tract trauma, perineal trauma, macrosomia, and a 1-minute APGAR score < 8/10, but not with mode of delivery.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery (normal vaginal/instrumental delivery and cesarean section) was not significantly different between the groups.
